findings.description: Critical: Acceptance tasks 3.1–3.3 are marked complete, but at HEAD `f16b8d3f` there is still no live coordinator/PostgreSQL proof for three successive phase rows, crash/resume reconcile-from-file, GitHub-backend override resistance, 100-row cleanup, connected SSE refresh, or the >50 lower-priority issue `/issues/list` visibility window within 5 seconds. `agent-coordinator/tests/test_autopilot_projection_visibility.py` only string-scans migration 037 and unit-tests SSE coalescing with a FakeBus; round-1 deferred the live proof to VALIDATE and it remains absent. This leaves proposal acceptance and design D5 unverified.
findings.resolution: Add postgres-gated integration tests that exercise live submit/reconcile/label repair, resume after mid-projection kill, SSE snapshot membership, and label-only `/issues/list` after seeding >50 ordinary lower-priority issues; keep them skip-tolerant when the integration DB is unavailable, and uncheck or annotate tasks 3.1–3.3 until they pass.

findings.description: Critical: Design D7 and task 1.1 require adapter tests that project at least three successive generations so first-insert and same-generation replay cannot hide an inverted submit/reconcile mapping. `skills/tests/autopilot/test_queue_projection.py` covers one-shot identity, a single `reconciliation_required` fallthrough, mismatch degradation, and reconcile cleanup, but never drives three increasing `(phase, transition_sequence)` generations through the adapter.
findings.resolution: Add a RED/GREEN adapter test that submits three successive LoopState generations, asserts head-advance via the exact nested HTTP-409 `reconciliation_required` envelope where needed, and proves same-generation replay stays idempotent while `projection_generation_mismatch` remains degraded.

findings.description: Critical: `runner.py project-state` returns exit 1 for any non-ok projection envelope (`return 0 if result.get("status") == "ok" else 1` at runner.py:436), the same class used for missing-state I/O failures (lines 429–431). SKILL.md:84–85 says projection failure is degraded and must not rewrite loop-state, but never tells the host to continue phase work on a non-zero `project-state` exit. Coordinated hosts that treat any non-zero as a stop will halt an otherwise healthy run on a transient coordinator/label outage, violating observability-only projection.
findings.resolution: Keep exit 1/2 for load/validation/transport crashes, but return 0 with `{"status":"degraded",...}` on the stdout envelope for business/coordinator degradation—or explicitly document and test that hosts must continue after non-zero `project-state` when stdout reports degraded.

findings.description: none: Exact nested HTTP-409 reconciliation remains narrow and spec-correct. `_requires_reconciliation` demands `status=error`, `status_code=409`, dict `response`, and `detail == "reconciliation_required"` (queue_projection.py:149-158); sibling `projection_generation_mismatch` degrades without reconcile (`test_only_exact_reconciliation_required_conflict_advances_head`).

none: Projection issue helpers treat HTTP-200 business failures as non-success. `_require_projection_operation_success` (coordination_bridge.py:1233-1247) keeps status ok only when `response.success is True`; `try_projection_issue_update`/`list` route through it, and the adapter degrades on non-ok label/list/cleanup envelopes.

none: Migration 037 removes legacy `claim_task` overloads before installing the sole issue-excluding form (DROP of 3-arg and 5-arg signatures at lines 7-8; `AND task_type <> 'issue'` at line 25), so unfiltered SQL callers cannot resolve a historical overload that would claim projection rows.

none: One capability snapshot is detected once per adapter call and reused for the full submit/reconcile/label/list/cleanup chain via `_coordination_state` (queue_projection.py:60-82; coordination_bridge.py:531-533). `test_projection_reuses_one_capability_snapshot_for_all_bridge_calls` pins identity reuse.

none: SSE projection coalescing and unsubscribe remain sound. `_on_task_event` latches `projection_refresh_pending` and enqueues one marker for `projection.labels_changed` bursts (event_stream.py:276-280); consumption paths clear the latch so mid-refresh events re-arm exactly once; the `finally` block identity-unregisters both bus callbacks (355-360).

none: Coordinator-free isolation is structural. `runner.py` imports `queue_projection` only inside `_cmd_project_state` (418-419); `persist_and_project` short-circuits when `queue_projection_fn is None`; AST and fail-fast transport spies in `test_phase_projection_isolation.py` prove no publisher traffic on the callback-free path.

none: OpenAPI work-queue revision 2 declares `/work/reconcile`, `projection_key`, `ProjectionMutationResult` including `cancelled_task_ids`, and Problem401/403/409/422 as `application/problem+json`; `test_projection_openapi_problem_contract_matches_runtime` locks parity with the runtime handlers.

none: Installed skill mirror parity holds at HEAD `f16b8d3f`. Canonical sources under `skills/` for autopilot `SKILL.md`, `queue_projection.py`, `runner.py`, `autopilot.py`, and coordination-bridge `coordination_bridge.py` are byte-identical to both `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/` mirrors.

none: Runner pending/validation/operational exits are distinct for the mutation writers. `_cmd_transition` returns 0 for `GatePending`, 2 for `ValueError`, and 1 for `OSError` (runner.py:401-409); focused runner tests cover gate-pending stop, unknown-outcome exit 2, and missing-state project-state I/O exit 1.
